title: Explorer action
responsibility: Renders a button or real navigation link with optional icons.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.href
inputs.description: Optional address passed as the href of the rendered link. A nonempty href with disabled false renders an hx-a link, while an empty or omitted href, or disabled set to true, renders an hx-button instead.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.onclick
inputs.description: Optional click handler that receives the MouseEvent; on a link it runs only for a plain click, with preventDefault called first, and a click with a modifier or with another mouse button is left to the browser. On a button it is called for each click the button receives.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.disabled
inputs.description: Defaults to false. When true, the action renders as a disabled hx-button even if href is set, so no link is rendered.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.tone
inputs.description: Defaults to gold. The chosen value is added as a class beside hx-action to select the gold or plain styling, and the styles for those classes are not defined in this file.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.icon
inputs.description: Optional trailing icon, drawn after the children content at size 18. Its value is a HarnessIconName, one of the keys of harnessIcons; when undefined, no trailing icon is rendered.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.lead
inputs.description: Optional leading icon, drawn before the children content at size 18. Its value is a HarnessIconName, one of the keys of harnessIcons; when undefined, no leading icon is rendered.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.label
inputs.description: Optional fuller accessible name, set as the aria-label of the rendered link or button. When undefined, the component sets no aria-label.
examples: Show every unit in this group

inputs.name: HarnessAction.children
inputs.description: Required visible content of the action, rendered between the optional lead and icon. It is a Svelte Snippet that the component renders with the @render tag.

outputs.name: HarnessAction
outputs.description: The rendered action element is an hx-a link when href is nonempty and disabled is false, otherwise an hx-button with type button and its disabled flag, and it carries the hx-action class plus the tone class. It holds the optional lead icon, the children content and the optional icon, with both icons at size 18; it wraps long content within the control (max-width 100%, white-space normal, overflow-wrap anywhere), sets no focus-specific styling, and does not catch handler errors.

errors.name: Caller callback or content error
errors.description: The component contains no throw or catch of its own; errors thrown by the supplied onclick handler or by the children snippet pass through it uncaught, since it has no error boundary. For a link, preventDefault is called before the handler runs, so the default link action is canceled even when the handler throws.
